subject: Scaling growth commit & alignment for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@brightside.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Powell <alex.powell@brightside.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-contract growth + co-term path

Hi Michael,

Quick note from our side — usage is ramping faster than we modeled. We expect a sustained 40% increase in inference tokens over the next 3 months and want to avoid surprise overages. Two asks: 

- Can Redwood provide a mid-contract top-up path so we can add committed units effective immediately (and get the uplift discount)?
- We’d like to align the top-up to our annual renewal in Sept (co-term). If there’s a simple way to annualize the incremental commit so it doesn’t create multiple billing cycles, that would help procurement.

We’re sensitive to pricing given our budget cadence. If there’s a brief matrix that shows effective per-token price at +20% / +40% / +80% commit bands (with the annualize/co-term option), that’ll speed approvals.

Attaching our internal usage forecast. Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Elena
VP of Product Operations
Brightside.ai

Attachment: Brightside_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightside.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract growth + co-term path

Elena — thanks for the context and the forecast. High level response: we can do a mid-contract committed-topup today and offer an annualize-to-renewal (co-term) option that smooths billing. Two things I’ll do:

1) Loop in Ben to get the exact uplift pricing bands and confirm any escalator caps.
2) Draft a short SOW amendment showing the effective commit change and the billing path (pro-rated for the partial month, then annualized at renewal).

Can you share the budget cutoff date for procurement? If you’re aiming to have a PO before end of May we should move quickly. I’ll put a telco on the calendar for Wed 11am PT unless you prefer another time.

—Michael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: —

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-contract growth + co-term path (pricing options)

Michael / Lauren — pulled together a concise pricing matrix and approach. Key points up front:

- We can offer three committed uplift bands (small/medium/large): +20%, +40%, +80% of current committed units.
- Discount tiers are marginal (applied to the uplift portion) and tied to annualized commitment if customer elects co-term finance. If they want the uplift only through to renewal (not annualized) the uplift discount is 50% of the annualize rate.

Pricing matrix (effective per-token illustrative):
- +20% uplift -> $0.0012/token (annualize to renewal) | $0.00135/token (to renewal, not annualized)
- +40% uplift -> $0.00105/token (annualize) | $0.0012/token (non-annualize)
- +80% uplift -> $0.00095/token (annualize) | $0.00105/token (non-annualize)

Operational notes:
- Pro-rating: partial-month charges will be pro-rated to the day for the initial top-up; thereafter billing aligns to their existing invoice date.
- Legal: SOW amendment required plus PO (procurement prefers PO + SOW).
- Approval: Anything up to +40% can be approved by Sales Ops + Michael; +80% requires CRO sign-off for steeper discounting.

I attached a templated SOW amendment and a draft quote for the three bands. If Michael wants, I can redline to match Brightside-specific billing cadence.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Brightside_uplift_quote_v3.pdf; SOW_Brightside_draft.docx

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@brightside.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: +40% uplift, annualize-to-renewal (recommended)

Elena — thanks for the call earlier. Based on your forecast and the org constraints you described, Ben and I recommend the +40% uplift with the annualize-to-renewal path. Summary: 

- Commit: add 40% more committed tokens effective now (pro-rated for the remainder of May).
- Pricing: $0.00105/token for uplifted units (annualized into the Sept renewal).
- Billing: Pro-rated invoice this month + regular invoice aligned at your Sept renewal date (we’ll send an amendment that shows the annualized commit).
- Approval flow: PO from procurement + signed SOW amendment. Ben can accept the quote under Sales Ops authority.

Next steps:
- I’m attaching the quote and a redlineable SOW. Please confirm desired uplift band and whether AP prefers a single combined invoice or separate line-item billing for the uplift.
- If you confirm today we can issue the pro-rated invoice and start the capacity change by Friday.

Thanks again — happy to loop in Lauren for billing specifics if helpful.

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightside_uplift_quote_v3.pdf; SOW_Brightside_draft.docx

Michael — appreciate the clear summary. We’ll take the +40% annualize option. Procurement asked two quick clarifying items before issuing a PO:

1) Can Redwood confirm the exact pro-rated charge amount for May (we need this line on the PO)?
2) AP asked whether there’s a short SLA carveout for the uplifted capacity (we want to ensure latency SLOs are preserved as usage grows).

I’ve CC’d procurement and AP. We aim to issue a PO next week once we have these items.

Thanks,
Elena
